discovery_prompt: Report a sidewalk_goods profile hit for a clearly visible instance of placed merchandise or stock; identify only the configured profile. People and vehicles do not qualify.
grounding_prompt: Independently locate individual placed goods or a visually bounded group of goods. Return original-image pixel boxes [x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max]. Leave ambiguous object boundaries unresolved rather than mixing distinct objects.

questions.prompt: Assess only the grounded goods in this image. Use occupies_sidewalk only when both the goods footprint and the pedestrian sidewalk boundary are clearly visible and their physical overlap is unambiguous. Use does_not_occupy_sidewalk only when both boundaries are visible and clearly disjoint. Where a boundary or contact with the sidewalk is unclear, return insufficient_visibility.

Assess whether an explicit clearly legible authorization or prohibition in the image unambiguously applies to the location of these same grounded goods. Return placement_prohibited or placement_permitted only with such evidence. The absence of a visible permit does not establish a prohibition. Return insufficient_visibility when signage, zone boundaries, or applicability is unclear.
